text:
Which statement about a permanent bar magnet is correct?
A
It is made from a soft magnetic material.
B
It repels a non-magnetic material.
C
Its field lines cross each other where the magnetic field is strong.
D
Its N-pole repels the N-pole of another magnet.

options.label: A
options.text: It is made from a soft magnetic material.

options.label: C
options.text: Its field lines cross each other where the magnetic field is strong.

options.label: D
options.text: Its N-pole repels the N-pole of another magnet.
